t2.title: Young people still respect and follow traditional customs and values
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should young people still respect and follow traditional customs and values?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Why Art Galleries Still Matter

In an age where we can view masterpieces on our phones, some question whether physical galleries remain relevant. Having visited many exhibitions, I believe they're more important than ever.

Firstly, experiencing art in person is fundamentally different. The scale, texture, and physical presence of artworks create emotional connections that screens cannot replicate.

Moreover, galleries provide curated experiences. The thoughtful arrangement of works, lighting, and space guides our interpretation in ways online browsing cannot.

Additionally, galleries are social spaces. Discussing art with friends or strangers, attending openings, and participating in events creates community around culture.

However, I acknowledge that online access democratizes art, allowing people worldwide to experience collections they could never visit.

Ultimately, digital and physical complement each other. Online platforms can inspire visits, while galleries offer irreplaceable experiences.

When did you last visit a gallery?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I go to the art place. It is good. I like the colors. I like the big one. My mom likes it too. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I went to the art gallery. It was nice and I saw many paintings. I liked some paintings but some were strange. The gallery was big and there were many people. I like art because it is fun. I want to see more paintings next time.
Bye!
t2.sampleB1:
Hi everyone,
I think young people should respect some traditional customs. In my opinion, it's important to know where you come from. For example, my family always celebrates a special holiday and I like learning about why we do it. However, some customs are old-fashioned and maybe not good for today. It depends on the custom. I also think values are important, like being kind and honest. These are good for everyone. So, I think we should keep the good things from the past but also be open to new ideas.
What do you think?
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, This is such a great topic, and I've been mulling it over for a while. In my view, young people absolutely should hold on to traditional customs and values — but with a bit of common sense. For me, traditions are what tie us to our roots. Sitting down with the whole family for a holiday meal, or learning the traditional crafts my grandparents grew up with, gives me a real sense of belonging and pride. Values like honesty, respect for elders and helping your neighbours never go out of fashion, and I'd hate to see them fade away. That said, I don't think we should follow every custom blindly. Some old habits simply don't fit the modern world, especially ones that treat certain people unfairly, and clinging to those does more harm than good. The trick, I reckon, is to keep what still makes sense and gently let go of the rest. At the end of the day, it's about striking a balance — honouring the past while keeping an open mind. What do the rest of you think? Do you keep up your family traditions? Dilshod
t2.uzSample:
Nega San'at Galereyalari Hali Ham Muhim?

Biz telefonlarimizda durdona asarlarni ko'rishimiz mumkin bo'lgan davrda, ba'zilar jismoniy galereyalar o'z ahamiyatini saqlab qolganmi degan savolni berishadi. Ko'plab ko'rgazmalarga tashrif buyurganimdan so'ng, men ularning har qachongidan ham muhimroq ekanligiga ishonaman.

Birinchidan, san'atni shaxsan his qilish tubdan farq qiladi. Asarlarning masshtabi, tuzilishi va jismoniy mavjudligi ekranlar takrorlay olmaydigan hissiy aloqalarni yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, galereyalar kuratsiya qilingan tajribalarni taqdim etadi. Asarlarning o'ylab topilgan joylashuvi, yoritilishi va makoni bizning talqinimizni onlayn ko'rish imkoniyatidan farqli ravishda yo'naltiradi.

Bundan tashqari, galereyalar ijtimoiy makonlardir. Do'stlar yoki notanish odamlar bilan san'atni muhokama qilish, ochilish marosimlarida qatnashish va tadbirlarda ishtirok etish madaniyat atrofida jamiyat yaratadi.

Biroq, men onlayn kirish san'atni demokratlashtirishini tan olaman, bu butun dunyo bo'ylab odamlarga ular hech qachon tashrif buyura olmaydigan kollektsiyalarni ko'rish imkonini beradi.

Oxir oqibat, raqamli va jismoniy bir-birini to'ldiradi. Onlayn platformalar tashriflarni ilhomlantirishi mumkin, galereyalar esa o'rnini bosib bo'lmaydigan tajribalarni taklif qiladi.

Oxirgi marta qachon galereyaga tashrif buyurdingiz?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men san'at joyiga boraman. U yaxshi. Menga ranglar yoqadi. Menga kattasi yoqadi. Onamga ham yoqadi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Men san'at galereyasiga bordim. U juda yaxshi edi va men ko'plab rasmlarni ko'rdim. Menga ba'zi rasmlar yoqdi, lekin ba'zilari g'alati edi. Galereya katta edi va odamlar ko'p edi. Menga san'at yoqadi, chunki u qiziqarli. Keyingi safar yana ko'proq rasmlarni ko'rmoqchiman.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hammaga salom,
Menimcha, yoshlar ba'zi an'anaviy urf-odatlarni hurmat qilishlari kerak. Mening fikrimcha, qayerdan kelib chiqqaningizni bilish muhim. Misol uchun, mening oilam har doim maxsus bayramni nishonlaydi va men nima uchun buni qilishimiz haqida bilishni yaxshi ko'raman. Biroq, ba'zi urf-odatlar eskirgan va bugungi kun uchun yaxshi bo'lmasligi mumkin. Bu urf-odatga bog'liq. Menimcha, qadriyatlar ham muhim, masalan, mehribon va halol bo'lish. Bular hamma uchun yaxshi. Shunday qilib, menimcha, biz o'tmishdagi yaxshi narsalarni saqlab qolishimiz kerak, lekin yangi g'oyalarga ham ochiq bo'lishimiz kerak.
Siz nima deb o'ylaysiz?
t2.uzSampleB2:
Salom,
Yoshlar an'anaviy urf-odatlar va qadriyatlarga rioya qilishlari kerakmi degan savol murakkab masala. Menimcha, o'z madaniy merosini tushunish va hurmat qilish juda muhim, lekin an'analarga ko'r-ko'rona rioya qilish cheklanishga olib kelishi mumkin. An'anaviy urf-odatlar ko'pincha o'zlik va mansublik hissini beradi va ularni tushunish hayotimizni boyitishi mumkin. Misol uchun, madaniy festivallarda ishtirok etish yoki an'anaviy hunarmandchilikni o'rganish bizni ildizlarimizga bog'lashi mumkin.

Biroq, ba'zi an'analar eskirgan yoki hatto zamonaviy dunyoda zararli bo'lishi mumkin. Urf-odatlar va qadriyatlarni tanqidiy baholash, tengsizlik yoki kamsitishni targ'ib qiladiganlarga qarshi chiqish muhim. Bundan tashqari, yoshlar shunchaki avlodlarning qadriyatlarini qabul qilishdan ko'ra, o'z qadriyatlari va e'tiqodlarini rivojlantirishga undalishi kerak. An'anani hurmat qilish va taraqqiyotni qabul qilish o'rtasidagi muvozanat sog'lom va dinamik jamiyat uchun zarurdir. Sizning fikringiz qanday?

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is interested in art. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I just visited the art exhibition at City Gallery – it was absolutely stunning! The modern sculptures were particularly impressive. You should definitely go before it ends! Let me know if you want to visit together!

Hi!

You go. Bye!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi!
I went to art place. It was good. I saw paintings and sculptures. They were nice. You like art, so you should go. It is fun.
Bye!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Islom,

I went to the art exhibition at City Gallery. I think it was interesting. There were many different types of art, like paintings and sculptures. I especially liked the paintings. In my opinion, you should go because you like art. It is open until next week.

See you soon,
Otabek Salimov
t11.sampleB2: Hey Islom, You'll never guess where I've just been — the Contemporary Art Exhibition at City Gallery! Honestly, it blew me away. The abstract sculptures are right up your street. You've got to check it out before it wraps up next week. Fancy going together? Let me know! Cheers, Bekzod Aliyev

t11.uzSampleA2:

Men san'at joyiga bordim. Yaxshi edi. Men rasmlar va haykallarni ko'rdim. Ular chiroyli edi. Senga san'at yoqadi, shuning uchun sen borishing kerak. Bu qiziqarli.

t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom, Islom,

Men shahar galereyasidagi san'at ko'rgazmasiga bordim. Menimcha, u qiziqarli edi. U yerda turli xil san'at turlari bor edi, masalan, rasmlar va haykallar. Menga ayniqsa rasmlar yoqdi. Mening fikrimcha, siz borishingiz kerak, chunki siz san'atni yaxshi ko'rasiz. U keyingi haftagacha ochiq.

Tez orada ko'rishguncha,

t11.uzSampleB2:
Aziz Islom,

Yaqinda shahar galereyasida Zamonaviy San'at Ko'rgazmasiga tashrif buyurdim va darhol seni o'yladim! U yerda juda hayratlanarli asarlar bor edi, ayniqsa abstrakt haykallar. Ko'rgazma tartibi yaxshi o'ylangan va ma'lumot panellari juda foydali ekanligini aniqladim.

San'atga bo'lgan ishtiyoqingizni hisobga olib, yopilishidan oldin tashrif buyurishingizni chin dildan tavsiya qilaman. Ishonamanki, bu sizga ham rag'batlantiruvchi, ham yoqimli bo'ladi. Agar xohlasang, hatto birga ham borishimiz mumkin?

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Otabek Salimov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the art gallery. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear City Art Gallery Team,

I am writing to share my thoughts on your Contemporary Art Exhibition.

Firstly, the variety of artworks was truly impressive. The combination of paintings, sculptures, and digital installations created a dynamic experience.

Moreover, the exhibition layout allowed visitors to flow naturally through the space.

However, I have some suggestions. Adding audio guides would help visitors understand the artistic context better.

Additionally, organizing artist talks or guided tours would enhance engagement and deepen appreciation of the works.

Furthermore, hosting exhibitions featuring local artists would support the community's creative talent.

Thank you for enriching our city's cultural life.

Best regards,
An Art Enthusiast
t12.sampleA1:
Hi City Art Gallery,


I see art. It is good. I like the paintings. The room is big. I want more art.


Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear City Art Gallery,


I went to the art show. It was good. I liked the paintings and the statues. But the information was not so good. I want to know more about the artists. Maybe you can have more information next time, because I want to learn.


Thank you,


A Visitor
t12.sampleB1:
Dear City Art Gallery Team,


I am writing to you about the Contemporary Art Exhibition I visited recently. I thought the exhibition was quite good overall. I especially liked the paintings, and the sculptures were interesting too. The layout was easy to follow, so that was helpful.


However, I think there are some things you could improve. For example, it would be good to have more information about the artists and their work. In my opinion, this would make the exhibition more engaging. Also, maybe you could have some events, like talks by the artists.


Thank you for the exhibition.


Sincerely,


A Visitor
t12.sampleB2: Dear City Art Gallery Team, I am writing to share my impressions of your recent Contemporary Art Exhibition, which I had the pleasure of visiting last weekend. On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed. The range of artworks on display was wonderfully varied, and the layout guided visitors smoothly from one section to the next. That said, I felt the information panels were a little brief, and I would have welcomed more detail about the artists and the ideas behind their work. Looking ahead, I would be delighted to see exhibitions showcasing local talent, as well as the occasional hands-on workshop. Such events would, I believe, draw a wider audience and deepen visitors' appreciation of contemporary art. Thank you for brightening our city's cultural scene. I look forward to your next exhibition. Yours faithfully, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli shahar badiiy galereyasi jamoasi,

Avvalo, san'at asarlarining xilma-xilligi haqiqatan ham hayratlanarli edi. Rassomlik, haykaltaroshlik va raqamli installyatsiyalarning kombinatsiyasi dinamik tajriba yaratdi.

Bundan tashqari, ko'rgazma joylashuvi tashrif buyuruvchilarga makonda tabiiy ravishda harakatlanish imkonini berdi.

Biroq, menda ba'zi takliflar bor. Audio gidlarni qo'shish tashrif buyuruvchilarga badiiy kontekstni yaxshiroq tushunishga yordam beradi.

Bundan tashqari, rassomlarning nutqlarini yoki ekskursiyalarni tashkil etish ishtirokni kuchaytiradi va asarlarni chuqurroq qadrlashga yordam beradi.

Shuningdek, mahalliy rassomlarning ko'rgazmalarini o'tkazish jamiyatning ijodiy iste'dodini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

Shahrimizning madaniy hayotini boyitganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
San'at ixlosmandi

Hurmatli shahar san'at galereyasi jamoasi,


Men yaqinda tashrif buyurgan Zamonaviy San'at Ko'rgazmasi haqida sizga yozmoqdaman. Menimcha, ko'rgazma umuman olganda juda yaxshi edi. Menga ayniqsa rasmlar yoqdi, haykallar ham qiziqarli edi. Joylashuvi tushunarli edi, shuning uchun bu foydali bo'ldi.


Biroq, menimcha, siz yaxshilashingiz mumkin bo'lgan ba'zi narsalar bor. Misol uchun, rassomlar va ularning ishlari haqida ko'proq ma'lumotga ega bo'lish yaxshi bo'lardi. Mening fikrimcha, bu ko'rgazmani yanada qiziqarli qiladi. Shuningdek, ehtimol, siz rassomlarning nutqlari kabi ba'zi tadbirlarni o'tkazishingiz mumkin.


Ko'rgazma uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,


Bir Tashrif Buyuruvchi
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli shahar san'at galereyasi jamoasi,


Men yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan Zamonaviy San'at Ko'rgazmasi haqida o'z fikrlarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Men san'at asarlarining tanlovi juda xilma-xil va rag'batlantiruvchi ekanligini, hozirgi san'at tendentsiyalari haqida keng nuqtai nazarni taqdim etishini aniqladim. Galereya maydonining joylashuvi odatda yaxshi o'ylab topilgan bo'lib, ko'rgazma bo'ylab qulay va intuitiv oqimga imkon beradi.


Biroq, kelajakdagi ko'rgazmalarda tashrif buyuruvchilar tajribasini yaxshilashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta takliflarim bor. Birinchidan, taqdim etilgan ma'lumotlar etarli bo'lsa-da, rassomlarning tarjimai hollari va ularning ishlarining kontseptual asoslarini kengaytirish foydali bo'ladi. Ehtimol, rassomlarning bayonotlarini yoki qisqa video intervyularni kiritish bunga erishishi mumkin.


Ikkinchidan, ko'proq interaktiv elementlarni, masalan, seminarlar yoki ekskursiyalarni taklif qilish, namoyish etilayotgan san'at bilan chuqurroq aloqani rivojlantirishi mumkin. Bu kengroq auditoriyani qamrab oladi va zamonaviy san'atni yanada chuqurroq qadrlashga undaydi.


Madaniy boyitish uchun bunday imkoniyatlarni taqdim etganingiz uchun tashakkur.


Hurmat bilan,


Galereya tashrif buyuruvchisi
